criteria.requirement: Implement sqlglot.report.prepare_report(query,*,values=None,tables=None,max_rows=None,offset=0,read=None,write=None) returning frozen PreparedReport(sql,tables,output_columns,parameters). Compose completed inspection/remap/bind/bounds APIs: parse once, require every supplied table mapping to match, bind every named parameter strictly, capture output projection names before optional outer limit and inspect final actual physical tables. Retain original unique parameter names and compile to requested dialect. No unresolved named placeholders or silent extras, offset requires bounds. Preserve supplied AST and do not execute SQL or fabricate schema/lineage.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
